summary: Battle City entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Battle City
entries.definitive_edition: Original Famicom release, with Arcade Archives VS. BATTLE CITY documented separately

emulation.emulator: Mesen or another accurate NES/Famicom emulator; Arcade Archives wrapper for VS. route
emulation.notes: Use original cart/hardware if validating input and display behavior.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Famicom hardware for the home release; original VS. hardware for the arcade variant

primary.why: The Famicom original is the baseline Battle City release and includes the home-game identity, co-op, and level-editor context. Arcade Archives VS. Battle City is a useful current arcade route, but it represents the VS. arcade version rather than replacing the Famicom original.
primary.how_to_play: Use original Famicom hardware or an accurate NES/Famicom emulator. Record ROM/cart region, emulator/core, controller, display scaling, two-player/co-op state, level editor use, and whether the 2024 Arcade Archives VS release was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Current official VS. arcade release route
secondary.what_to_play: Use for the arcade version and online leaderboard/display-option route.
secondary.why: It is a distinct arcade route and convenient current access path.
It is not the Famicom original.
